en.help_tooltip:
Your Colony will find some amount of food over each timeskip, but successful foraging patrols are the most important source of food. You can see what was consumed and gathered in the Log below! Food can't be stored endlessly: after four moons food will rot and will be thrown away. Ants under 3 moons with a parent (broodmother) taking care of them don't need food.

Feeding the Colony is very important, therefore ants will be fed before any changes to rank. Hover your mouse over the pile to see the current and needed amount of food for your Clan!
en.prey_amount_info: Up to %{warrior_amount} workers can be fed with this amount of food.
en.prey_amount_none: The food pile is empty, the Colony desperately needs food!
en.prey_amount_very_low: The food pile can't even feed half of the Colony. Foraging patrols should be organized immediately.
en.prey_amount_low: Only half of the Colony can be fed currently. Foraging patrols should be organized.
en.prey_amount_average: Every mouth of the Colony can be fed, but some more food would not harm.
en.prey_amount_high: The food pile is overflowing and the Colony can feast!
en.prey_amount_very_high: SunColony has blessed the Colony with plentiful food and the leader sends their thanks to Silverbloom.
